purpose: Source declarations and original target-release section population diagnostic, not answer admission
original_English: List CRs whose affected clauses match actual sections of spec 38.423 (clause-to-section validation).
whole_original_population_SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT cr.node_id,cr.tdocNumber,cr.type,cr.status,cr.crNumber,cr.crRevision,
                cr.clausesAffected,m.meetingNumber,r.releaseName
        FROM CR cr JOIN rel_MODIFIES mod ON mod.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=mod.dst_id
        LEFT JOIN rel_PRESENTED_AT p ON p.src_id=cr.node_id LEFT JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=p.dst_id
        LEFT JOIN rel_TARGET_RELEASE tr ON tr.src_id=cr.node_id LEFT JOIN Release r ON r.node_id=tr.dst_id
        WHERE sp.specNumber='38.423' ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber,m.meetingNumber,r.releaseName

literal_lines.text: | **Release 차원 (release-aware)** | 각 TS의 **release별 final 버전** (Rel-15/16/17/18/19). 동일 spec번호라도 release마다 **별개 Spec 노드**이며, sectionId·Spec IRI가 release 키를 포함한다 (예: `38.413-Rel-15-...` ≠ `38.413-Rel-17-...`). spec×release = spec-release 단위로 적재 (spec-release 수는 Appendix A.1.3 참조) |
| **TS 간 참조** | Section 간 내부/외부 참조 |
| Section 본문 텍스트 | Vector DB 영역 |
| Table 셀 데이터 | Vector DB 영역 |
| **ASN.1 본문 텍스트** | Vector DB 영역. Section 노드(sectionId, sectionNumber, title, level)는 포함하되, ASN.1 코드 본문은 Graph DB에 저장하지 않음 |
| TS **intra-release** 버전 히스토리 (한 release 내 모든 draft/중간 버전) | 복잡도 증가, 향후 확장. release별 **final 버전 1개**만 적재 (release-aware). 각 release final의 버전값은 Spec 확장의 specVersion에 기록 (Step 4 §6 참조) |
| RAN3 외 TS (36.xxx 등) | Scope 한정 |
Phase-1 CR의 clausesAffected 속성을 파싱하여 Section 식별:
- CR의 modifies → Spec에서 specNumber 확인 + CR의 대상 release 확인
- 나머지 CR은 Spec 레벨까지만 연결 (CR → Spec)

scope_finding: RAN3's own original phase3 design explicitly selects one final edition per Rel15–19 and joins CR targetRelease to same-release Section. Exact equality of historical CurrentVersion to a retained edition is not a prerequisite under that design. CurrentVersion-only, arbitrary latest and all-edition union are different predicates.
scope_limits: This design supports a targetRelease candidate population; seven-unit required-role/existential-vs-all interpretation and complete raw declaration/section grammar still require exact independent review. Current source bytes are pinned; historical immutability is not invented.
source_limits: Blank source clause values, absent column or missing form remain unknown for authored affected scope. Imported original-format XLSX/XLSM origin is pinned without fabricating raw ZIP provenance. All source versions/rows are retained, not selected because values match. No status/formal-number filter is added.
